lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The grand hall of Vallhelm is suffocatingly silent, save for the crackling hum of the ancient summoning circle etched into the marble floor. The air is thick with the scent of ozone, burning sage, and the cold sweat of desperate men.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: King Galvath Valerius stands at the edge of the circle, his knuckles white as he grips the armrest of his throne. The Demon Lord's armies are a day's march away, and the kingdom's last hope rests on this forbidden ritual.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A flash of blinding, golden light erupts from the center of the runes. The shockwave knocks the royal mages off their feet, sending ancient scrolls fluttering into the air. When the smoke clears, the entire court gasps in unison.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Instead of a towering, armored warrior, a young woman stands in the center of the circle. She is wearing a simple, black-and-white maid's uniform, holding a feather duster like a sword. Her name is Mika Amanogawa.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: Whoa! What the—? Where am I? One minute I'm scrubbing a stubborn coffee stain out of a hotel carpet, and the next I'm in a fantasy LARPing convention. Why is everyone staring at me like I just grew a second head?

lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
lines.text: A servant! The prophecy promised a champion to save us from the abyss, and the heavens send us a scullery maid with a duster! The heavens mock us! Do they think a duster can parry a demon blade?

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Murmurs of panic ripple through the court. The royal mages exchange terrified glances. The circle had responded, but to what? To whom?

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: Look, buddy, I don't know who you are or where this is, but I'm just as confused as you are. And frankly, I'd like to go back to my hotel. I have a schedule.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika takes a tentative step forward, her shoes clicking against the marble. She feels the hum of magic beneath her feet, a strange warmth that seems to recognize her.

choices.text: Step forward and offer to help her

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
text: Father, please! Silence! The circle responded to her. The magic recognized her soul. We cannot dismiss her just because she doesn't look like a knight.
Father, please! Silence! The circle responded to her. The magic recognized her soul. We cannot dismiss her just because she doesn't look like a knight.

Father, please! Silence! But... why do I feel like I've seen her before? Something about her eyes... it terrifies me. Yet, we must not dismiss her.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: A young woman with tired, kind eyes steps forward from the shadows of the throne. Princess Mallory Valerius, the King's eldest daughter, looks at Mika not with disgust, but with desperate curiosity.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Thanks for the save. I'm Mika, by the way. Mika Amanogawa. Nice to meet someone here who isn't immediately yelling at me.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I am Mallory. And I have a feeling we are going to need each other if we are going to survive this. Welcome to Vallhelm, Mika.

choices.text: Stand your ground and demand respect

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I can hear you, you know. I'm standing right here. And for the record, I've handled worse messes than a few angry soldiers. Have you ever cleaned up after a royal banquet?

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The court gasps at her defiance. The King's face turns crimson with rage, and the guards tighten their grip on their weapons. The air grows cold.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Silence! The circle responded to her. We cannot dismiss her just because she doesn't look like a knight. Stand down! I will not have bloodshed in the summoning chamber!

choices.text: Stay silent and observe the court

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika narrows her eyes, saying nothing. She takes in the panicked nobles, the trembling mages, and the furious King. She catalogs every exit, every weapon.

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Nothing to say for yourself? A silent servant is at least better than a babbling one. Guards, take her to the dungeons until we can figure out this mess.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: No! Father, I will vouch for her. If the magic brought her here, she is our responsibility. I will take her to the gardens to speak.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Hold on. Look at these runes. They're not just a summoning circle. They're a binding spell. You didn't just call me here, you trapped me.

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: What? That's impossible! The ritual was supposed to bring a champion!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: She's right. I can see the binding threads. Father, what have you done? She's not a guest, she's a prisoner. We owe her our apologies and our help.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The court's disappointment sharpens into suspicion. A seasoned captain of the guard steps forward, pointing his spear directly at Mika's untouched sleeves.

lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
lines.text: If the ritual brought a servant, then it has failed us. We need a champion who can wield a blade, not someone to dust the throne room while the kingdom burns.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: I'm right here, you know. I have a name. It's Mika. And honestly, I'm just as confused as you are. But pointing weapons at people is a terrible way to make a first impression.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The tension in the room is palpable. The guards look nervous, their eyes darting between the King and the strange woman in the circle.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Look, I don't know how I got here, but I'm not your enemy. I was just doing my job, and now I'm here. I just want to figure out how to go home without anyone getting hurt.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The King hesitates, his expression softening slightly at her calm, rational tone. He lowers his hand, signaling the guards to stand down.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Let us speak in the gardens, away from this hostility. Please, follow me. We have much to discuss.

choices.text: Tell the King to shut up

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Maybe if your kingdom wasn't such a mess, the heavens wouldn't have sent a maid. Ever think of that? Maybe try cleaning up your own messes for once.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The guards tighten their grip on their weapons. The air grows cold, and the nearest torch gutters out. The King's face twists with fury.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Guards, to me! We need to get her out of here before this turns into a bloodbath. Father, please, let me handle this.

choices.text: Point out the flaws in their defense

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Instead of pointing spears at me, maybe you should point them at the Demon Lord. Look at this formation! If I were attacking this castle, I'd hit the east wall. It's completely undefended.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The captain of the guard blinks, looking at the map on the wall, then back at Mika. His jaw drops.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: She's right. The east wall is our weakest point. Perhaps the prophecy sent us someone who thinks before she fights. Follow me, Mika.

choices.text: Ask for a weapon to prove yourself

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: You want a champion? Give me a sword. I'll fight your best guard right here, right now.

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: You? A maid? Fine. If you win, I will listen. If you lose, you go to the dungeons.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika picks up a guard's sword, her hands surprisingly steady. She disarms the guard in three swift movements, leaving him on the floor.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Impressive. You didn't just win, you did it without drawing blood. I think we found our champion.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mallory walks Mika out of the echoing throne room and into the quiet, sprawling palace gardens. The night air is cool and carries the sweet scent of night-blooming jasmine.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: They sit on a stone bench near a gently bubbling fountain. The distant sound of the panicked court fades away, replaced by the chirping of crickets.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
text: I apologize for my father. He is terrified. We all are. Vallhelm has always relied on prophecy, and now that the prophecy is here... we forgot how to fight for ourselves. But I am not ready to give up on you yet.

I apologize for my father. He is terrified. We all are. Vallhelm has always relied on prophecy, and now that the prophecy is here... we forgot how to fight for ourselves. But I am not ready to give up on you yet.

I apologize for my father. He is terrified. We all are. Vallhelm has always relied on prophecy, and now that the prophecy is here... we forgot how to fight for ourselves. But I am not ready to give up on you yet.
I apologize for my father... But I can't help but feel a strange sense of dread around you. Like I shouldn't trust you. Like I've seen you do terrible things.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mallory pours a cup of steaming tea from a silver pot, handing it to Mika. The warmth seeps into Mika's cold fingers.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: It's okay. I'm used to people underestimating me. Let me see what I can do to help. I might not be a knight, but I'm a fast learner. And I'm great at organizing.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mallory smiles, a genuine, tired smile that reaches her eyes. She reaches out and gently squeezes Mika's hand.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: You are a rare soul, Mika. Thank you. Truly.

choices.text: Demand to be sent home immediately

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I don't care about your war or your prophecies. I want to go home. Now. Find a way to send me back.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I... I don't know how to send you back. The ritual only works one way. It binds you to us.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Then find a way. Or I'll find it myself.

choices.text: Ask her about the history of the ritual

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: This ritual... has it been used before? Who wrote it? There has to be a loophole, a reason why it brought me here.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: The archives are sealed, but I can get us in. If anyone can figure out the true nature of the summoning, it's you. I'll help you find the truth.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika nods. For the first time, she feels a sliver of hope. Not just of going home, but of understanding why she was chosen.

choices.text: Warn her about the upcoming war

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: The Demon Lord's armies are a day's march away. Your father is panicking. You need a plan, not a prophecy. I can help you strategize.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: You'd help us? Even after my father threatened you?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I don't abandon people in need. It's not in my nature. Even if I am wearing a maid's dress.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Before the sun rises, Mallory disguises herself in a heavy, worn cloak and takes Mika into the lower city. The streets are damp with morning fog, and the market is bustling, but a thick layer of fear hangs in the air.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The people are thin, their faces gaunt. The war has taken its toll on the kingdom's poorest.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: The people are scared. I used to clean rooms for people who never looked me in the eye. It's strange, being the one everyone is staring at now.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A small child, distracted by the commotion, bumps into Mika, dropping a woven basket of apples. The fruit scatters across the muddy cobblestones.

choices.text: Help the child gather the apples

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Oh! Careful there, little one. Let me help you. Don't want these delicious apples getting bruised.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika kneels in the mud, her pristine maid's uniform getting dirty as she gathers the apples. The child stares at her in awe.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: You care for them already. You have a gentle heart, Mika. A rare thing in these dark times.

choices.text: Ignore the child and keep walking

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Watch where you're going. I don't have time for this.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: That was cold, Mika. These are my people. They are suffering.

choices.text: Buy the child's entire basket of apples

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Here, let me buy the rest. You shouldn't be out here in this cold anyway. Go home to your family.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika presses a few silver coins into the child's hand. The child's eyes go wide, and they run off, beaming.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: You gave her more than enough to feed her family for a week. You didn't have to do that.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I know. But I wanted to.

choices.text: Ask the merchant about the food shortage

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Why is everything so expensive? The crops should be ready for harvest.

outcome_lines.speaker: Merchant
outcome_lines.text: The King's soldiers took most of it. Said it was for the war effort. We're starving, but the nobles eat like kings.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: That's... not right. My father wouldn't allow this.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Someone is, Mallory. And we need to find out who.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Back at the palace, tensions boil over. A frightened, young guard, believing Mika's intervention at the market was demonic manipulation, lunges at her with a spear.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika doesn't flinch. She pivots on her heel, sidestepping the thrust by a hair's breadth, grabs the wooden shaft of the spear, and snaps it in two with a sharp twist of her wrist.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: Enough! Stand down, soldier! Stand down! She could have broken your arm. Instead, she disarmed you without drawing a drop of blood. That takes skill.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A tall, imposing woman with silver armor and a scarred face steps forward. This is Lira Vanguard, Captain of the Royal Guard.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I know what fear makes people do. It's okay. Let's just make sure it doesn't happen again.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: You have my respect, Maid. I am Lira, Captain of the Royal Guard.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: If he tries that again, I won't be so gentle. Tell your men to stay out of my way.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Watch your tongue, Maid. You are not in charge here.

choices.text: Ask Lira about the guard's training

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: If your men are this jumpy, the Demon Lord won't even need to fight. They'll rout themselves.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: You're right. They are terrified. We all are. But seeing you disarm him without a scratch... it gives them pause. Maybe there's hope for us yet.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Wait a minute. This spear... it's not standard issue. The metal is too heavy, the balance is wrong.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: You noticed? It's a ceremonial weapon. We're running out of actual weapons. The treasury has been drained.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Drained? By who?

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: That's the question, isn't it? Follow me, Maid. We need to talk to the Princess.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: King Galvath, humbled but still suspicious, summons the three women to the restricted section of the royal archives. The room smells of old paper, ozone, and dust.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: He opens a massive, ancient tome bound in dragon leather. The pages glow with a faint, ethereal light.

lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
lines.text: This book names you, Mika Amanogawa. It describes fifty-five lives before this one. Each time, your memories were wiped clean. You are a cosmic pawn. A weapon to be spent and discarded.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: Fifty-five lives? You mean I've done this before? I've died before? Fifty-five times?

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The weight of the revelation hits Mika like a physical blow. Her hands tremble, her mind reeling with the implication of countless deaths.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Then let this life belong to me. I will help you, but I choose what home means. No more wiping my memories.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Thank you, Mika. We will stand by you.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I am not a pawn. I won't be your sacrifice. Find someone else to do your dirty work.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Please, Mika. We need you. The whole world needs you.

choices.text: Demand to know how to break the cycle

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: If this has happened fifty-five times, how did it end? Did I fail? Did I win? Tell me everything.

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: The book... it stops at the fifty-fifth page. The rest is blank. No one knows what happens next.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Then I'll write my own ending. One that doesn't involve me dying.

choices.text: Read the margins of the book

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika ignores the King and peers closely at the faded writing in the margins. Her eyes widen.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: These aren't just records. They're notes. From me. Past me. She wrote... 'Don't trust the King. He knows more than he says.'

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Father? Is this true?

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I... I don't know what that means. The book is ancient!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: It means the cycle is rigged. And I'm going to break it.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The training yard is filled with the harsh clang of steel. Lira is a whirlwind of precision and grace, her sword cutting through the air. Mika, however, is struggling to adjust to the weight of a real blade.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: Your strength is incredible, Mika, but your footwork is sloppy! You fight like you're holding a mop!

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: A mop can be pretty dangerous if you know how to swing it! I once fought off a drunk noble with a bucket of soapy water!

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Despite the taunts, Mika is learning fast. Her movements, while unorthodox, carry a raw, devastating power.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Lira laughs, a genuine, warm sound. She lunges again, but Mika anticipates it. She sweeps Lira's leg with the flat of her blade, knocking the captain into the dirt.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Good match, Captain.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: You are full of surprises, Maid. Perhaps you really are the hero the prophecy spoke of.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika disarms Lira with a swift strike, sending her sword clattering to the ground.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Not so tough now, are you, Captain?

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Don't push your luck, Maid. I was going easy on you.

choices.text: Ask Lira for a real fight

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Stop holding back. I need to know what it feels like to fight someone who actually wants to kill me.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Lira's eyes widen, then harden. She nods. The next exchange is brutal, leaving Mika bruised and breathless, but she doesn't yield.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: You are a glutton for punishment. But... I think you might actually survive this war.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: That scar on your face. Where did you get it?

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: The border. Three years ago. A demon took my eye, but I took its head. I earned this scar.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: It's a badge of honor. You're a true warrior.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: And you, Maid, are a quick learner. You'll be a warrior yet.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Days pass in relative peace, a calm before the inevitable storm. Mallory leads Mika to a hidden garden behind the palace walls, overgrown with wild roses and ivy.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: The palace garden is peaceful. No one will bother you here. This was my mother's favorite place.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: It's beautiful. A quiet place, a warm drink, and no urgent prophecy. I could get used to this.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: They sit together, watching the butterflies dance among the flowers. For a moment, the war feels a thousand miles away.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika smiles softly, the first genuine smile she has shown since arriving. They spend hours talking about her world, her small apartment, her love of cleaning, and the peaceful, mundane life she left behind.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I used to think my life was boring. Just waking up, going to work, coming home. But now... I'd give anything for one boring Tuesday.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: You make this place feel like home too, Mika.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika stares at the roses, refusing to meet Mallory's eyes.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'm not here to make friends, Mallory. I'm here because I have to be.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I see. I'm sorry for prying.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: What was she like? Your mother?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: She was strong. Stronger than my father. She used to tell me that true strength isn't about swinging a sword. It's about knowing when to put it down.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mallory's eyes water, but she doesn't cry. Mika quietly places a hand on her shoulder, offering silent comfort.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika carefully cuts a single wild rose, pricking her finger on a thorn in the process.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Ouch. Here. For you. A queen should have a flower.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: You're bleeding...

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: It's just a scratch. Don't worry about it.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Thank you, Mika. I'll treasure it.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The royal orchard on the outskirts of the city is in ruins. The wooden fence is cut from the inside. Wet footprints lead toward the goblin road, but none lead back.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: This wasn't an attack from the outside. Look at the cut. Someone from the city cut this from the inside and dragged the scouts out.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: We should report this to the King immediately. This is high treason.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: If we report this, the King will just send an army. Then the real traitor wins. We need to find out who benefits before we call anyone an enemy. We need evidence.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Agreed. We do this your way, Mika.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Let the army handle it. That's what they're paid for, right?

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: As you wish. I will inform His Majesty immediately.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'm going to follow the tracks. You two stay here and cover for me.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Are you insane? You'll be captured or killed!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I've died fifty-five times. I'm not afraid of the dark anymore.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika disappears into the woods before they can stop her.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Look at the prints. They're heavy, dragging. And they're wearing boots. City boots. Not goblin feet.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: You can read tracks?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I clean up messes. You learn to tell who made them.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Someone from the palace did this. Someone with access to the King's boots.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A goblin band storms the countryside, setting fire to the wheat fields. Mika shields Mallory, raising her broken spear to fight. But as the smoke clears, she notices the raiders are not warriors, but refugees.

lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
lines.text: Our village has nothing left! The blight took our crops, and the king's soldiers poisoned our wells! We came for food, not a war with your people!

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: Mika, what should we do? If we attack, we prove we're monsters. If we don't, they'll take everything.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika drops her weapon to the mud. The silence that follows is deafening. Gorthak stares at her, bewildered by her courage.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Put down your weapons. All of you. We can settle this without bloodshed.

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: Why should we trust you? You are human.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Because I'm the only one here who has seen enough death. Fifty-five lifetimes of it. I'm not looking for more.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika charges forward, her broken spear flashing in the firelight. The goblins scatter, terrified by her ferocity.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Drive them back! Show them what happens when they threaten Vallhelm!

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: We will remember this, human! We will remember!

choices.text: Offer them a place in the palace kitchens

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: If you're hungry, I know a place. The palace throws away more food in a day than you could eat in a month. Work for us, and you won't have to raid.

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: You would offer a goblin work? You are either very brave or very foolish.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Perhaps a little of both. But it's a better offer than a spear to the chest.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Wait. You said the King's soldiers poisoned your wells. Where did they do it? What did the poison look like?

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: It was black ash. It burned the water. It came from a councilman with a dark artifact.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: A councilman... Mallory, we need to get to the archives. Now.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Once the danger passes, Mika forces both sides to sit at the negotiating table. The tension in the throne room is thick enough to cut with a knife.

lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
lines.text: Give our people a fair chance, and we will stand between Vallhelm and its enemies. We are warriors, not thieves.

lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
lines.text: You expect me to ally with goblins? They have raided our lands for generations! My father died fighting them!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: And you expect me to fight for a kingdom that would let children starve over a grudge? A treaty is only worth something if we keep choosing to honor it.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Mika is right, Father. The real enemy is at our borders. We need Gorthak's army.

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: You are a strange human, Mika. You fight like a demon, but you speak like an angel.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'm not saying we hold hands and sing songs. I'm saying we accept a temporary truce until the Demon Lord is defeated.

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: A temporary measure. Nothing more. Do not expect me to break bread with them.

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: Cautious. But acceptable.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: You can either fight the goblins and the Demon Lord at the same time, or you can swallow your pride and accept their help. Choose wisely.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The King's face goes white. He looks at Mallory, then back at Mika, and slumps into his throne.

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: ...Fine. A truce. But I will not forgive them.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Father, why don't you tell them what you did? The poisoned wells? The black ash?

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: What? I did no such thing!

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: The human lies. We saw the councilman. Vane Blackwood. He wore the King's seal.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Then someone in this room is lying. And it's not the goblins.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika follows Gorthak to Crag-Vale, a goblin village nestled in the jagged mountains. It is a ruin of empty granaries, poisoned wells, and crying children. The smell of rot is overwhelming.

lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
lines.text: We did not raid your farms until the blight took ours. We were desperate. We are dying.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: Then we have been fighting over the same wound. Someone poisoned your wells, cut our fences, and killed our scouts. They wanted this war.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: A sudden whistle cuts through the air. An arrow strikes the ground between them, vibrating with force. Its shaft bears the king's seal.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Look at the shaft. It bears the king's seal. But he wouldn't... this is a forgery. We'll fix this, Gorthak. I promise.

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: Thank you, Mika. You are different from the others.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: A sudden whistle cuts through the air. An arrow strikes the ground between them, vibrating with force.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Who did this? Who poisoned your wells? Tell me what you know!

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: We don't know! We are not your enemy, but you are making it very hard to remember that!

choices.text: Offer to heal the sick children

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'm not a doctor, but I know a thing or two about cleaning up messes. Let me help the children while we talk.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika spends hours washing wounds and boiling water. The goblins watch her with a mixture of confusion and awe.

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: You have the hands of a healer and the heart of a warrior. Perhaps we have been wrong about humans.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: This isn't blight. It's alchemy. Someone did this on purpose.

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: Can you fix it?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I can try. But I'll need the help of the royal mages.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I'll convince my father. We owe your people this much.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The Demon Lord's forces gather at the border. A massive army of dark knights, wraiths, and fire-breathing beasts stretches across the horizon, blotting out the sun.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Knights, mages, and goblins stand shoulder to shoulder, preparing to defend Vallhelm together. The air smells of ozone, ash, and fear.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: You do not have to face the whole army by yourself. We are with you. Vallhelm is with you.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I know. I just need to remember that when the fighting starts. Fear makes people do terrible things. But it can also make them brave.

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: My people will hold the left flank. Show them the strength of a champion, Maid. We fight as one!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I can handle this. I've done it before. Just make sure the civilians are safe.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Be careful, Mika. Please. Don't do anything reckless.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: We don't need to meet them head-on. Gorthak, can your people create a diversion at the gorge while we flank them?

outcome_lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
outcome_lines.text: Aye. We are quick and quiet. We can draw them into the valley.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Brilliant. We'll catch them in a crossfire.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Look at the center. It's too thin. They're trying to bait us into a trap. If we strike the flanks and push inward, we can surround them.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: She's right. It's a classic envelopment tactic.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: We'll trust your eyes, Mika. Let's do it.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Before the war council can agree on a plan, the king's maps are found covered in black ash. Every road leads to the same ruined valley, a death trap.

lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
lines.text: The enemy is steering us toward the north. It's a trap. We have no choice but to spring it.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: Then we choose the ground together. Mika is not a weapon we point at it. We fight as one, or we don't fight at all.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: If we're walking into a trap, we make sure we spring it on our terms. We use the valley's terrain to our advantage.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Smart. We'll coordinate the mages to provide cover.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: We attack now. We don't give them time to fortify their positions.

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Reckless! You will get us all killed!

choices.text: Suggest a retreat to draw them out

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: We retreat. We give them the valley. And when they think they've won, we burn the forest around them.

outcome_lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Burn the forest? That's madness!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: It's war. You wanted a champion, and a champion doesn't fight fair.

choices.text: Expose the traitor in the room

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Wait. How did the maps get covered in ash? Someone in this room did it. Someone who wants us to walk into that trap.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika looks directly at Councilman Vane, who is sweating profusely in the corner.

outcome_lines.speaker: Vane Blackwood
outcome_lines.text: I... I don't know what you're talking about!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Lira, arrest him.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The battle is brutal. The valley runs red. The allied forces are pushed to the brink, but they hold the line. The battle breaks the enemy's advance, but at a terrible cost.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika spends everything she has to keep Mallory and the defenders alive. She channels the raw, unrefined magic of the summoning circle, feeling her very essence tearing apart.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: [shake]Mallory! Get behind me![/shake]

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: A blinding flash of light erupts from Mika's body, consuming the remaining shadow beasts. The blast levels the valley. When the light fades, Mika collapses into the mud.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Mika! Stay with us. Please. Don't close your eyes! I can't lose you!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The light fades from Mika's eyes. She smiles softly, knowing she saved them.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika lets out a final, exhausted sigh, closing her eyes as the magic consumes her.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'm sorry... I couldn't hold on...

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: She is gone. The cycle has claimed another life.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Lira! Take my hand! I can't hold it, but you can!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Lira grabs Mika's hand, and the magic flows through her, amplifying her sword strikes into arcs of pure light. She cuts down the remaining beasts in seconds.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: You... you saved us without dying! We did it together!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Together. That's the secret.

choices.text: Use the environment to your advantage

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika looks at the crumbling ruins around them. She dodges a blast of shadow and brings the entire ceiling down on top of the entity.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: She's insane! Brilliant, but insane!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The shadow roars as it is crushed under tons of stone.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Vallhelm mourns. The kingdom is saved, but the champion is gone. The capital is draped in black banners.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: You should not have to hold all this grief alone, Your Highness. You haven't left her side in days. You need to eat.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
text: I promised her she wouldn't be alone. I failed her. I couldn't protect her. She died for us.
I promised her she wouldn't be alone. I failed her. I couldn't protect her. She died for us.
I promised her she wouldn't be alone. I failed her. I couldn't protect her. She died for us.
I promised her... but maybe it's a mercy she died. I saw the way she looked at the King. She was a monster waiting to happen.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: She protected us. And she would want you to keep living. She wouldn't want you to waste away in this room. Let me help you.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Then stay beside me. And when Mika comes home, we will tell her together.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: As you wish, Your Highness. I will be outside if you need me.

choices.text: Promise to find a way to bring her back

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: There might be a way. The summoning circle... it's still glowing. Faintly. It might be enough.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Then we use it. We bring her back. I don't care what it costs.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: It's his fault. He sent her to the front lines. He wanted her to die so he could claim the victory.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Your Highness, please. We don't know that.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I know my father, Lira. And I know he'll pay for this.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Grief makes the days blur. To keep the palace running and to keep Mallory from drowning in sorrow, Lira asks to serve as her personal maid until Mika can return.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: It is not a replacement. I need help, and I trust you. You are my anchor in this storm.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: I will wear the apron, Your Highness. But I will never pretend to be Mika. She is one of a kind.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mallory laughs for the first time in weeks, though it is tinged with sadness. She pins Mika's pale ribbon beside the appointment order.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I know. She would be furious if we replaced her. She'd probably throw a bucket of soapy water at us.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: I'll do my best to keep your spirits up.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: It hurts, Lira. Every time I see you in that apron, it hurts.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: I'm sorry, Your Highness. I never meant to cause you pain.

choices.text: Ask Lira to teach you to fight

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: If Mika isn't here to protect us, I need to learn to protect myself. Teach me, Lira.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: It would be an honor, Your Highness. But let's start with a wooden sword. I don't want to explain to the King how you lost a finger.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: We should do something. A memorial. A statue. Something to remember her by.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: A statue in the garden. Where she loved to sit.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Yes. And we'll put a feather duster in her hand.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: At the garden memorial, Mallory and Lira speak to Mika as if she can still hear them. A soft, golden glow gathers around the fragments of her soul.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: Mallory...? Lira...? I'm all right. I could feel how much you wanted me back.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
text: You are home. This time, you do not have to be alone. We're here.
You are home. This time, you do not have to be alone. We're here.
You are home. This time, you do not have to be alone. We're here.
You are back... But I remember things. I remember the blood. I remember you killing me. Don't come any closer.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: It was dark. So dark. But I heard your voice calling me. It was like a lighthouse.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I missed you. Both of you. So much.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: We missed you too, Mika. Welcome back.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Thanks. For bringing me back. I guess.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Mika? What's wrong? Did something happen in the dark?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I don't want to talk about it right now.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't mean to leave you. I just... I wanted to protect you.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Don't apologize for saving our lives. Just... don't do it again. I can't go through that twice.

choices.text: Ask how long you were gone

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: How long was I out?

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Three weeks. Three weeks of the Princess crying over your grave.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'm sorry. I didn't know.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: You're here now. That's all that matters.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A servant mistakenly calls Lira the princess's 'new maid' in passing. Mika's smile falters. Lira is wearing the very apron Mika used to fold each morning.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: You found someone to take my place before I even came back. I was gone for five minutes. Well, a few weeks.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: Mika, please. Tell me what you heard. It's not what you think. Lira was just helping me survive.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I saved this world. I died for it. Why does it feel as if I have already been erased from it?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I was scared. I'm still scared. But I don't want to push you away.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I'm so sorry, Mika. I never meant to make you feel that way.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: You're all the same. Fifty-five times I've died for people, and fifty-five times I've been replaced the second I closed my eyes.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Mika, please! It's not like that!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Then what is it like? Because it looks exactly like that from where I'm standing.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: A maid? Lira? She can't even fold a napkin. No offense, Captain.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: None taken. I'm better with a sword than a duster.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Good. Because I'm not sharing my apron.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Lira, I need you to take off the apron. You're a warrior, not a maid.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: If that's what you want, I'll do it. But I was only trying to help.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Lira removes the apron and leaves the room without another word. Mallory looks at Mika with a mix of sadness and disappointment.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika, Mallory, and Lira retreat to the archive to talk. A window slams shut though there is no wind. An ink-black handprint appears on the inside of the glass, smoking slightly.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: When I heard 'new maid,' it felt like the last place in the world that was mine disappeared. Like I was just a ghost.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: I wanted to keep your place warm. I never wanted to stand in it. I'm sorry, Mika.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I know you didn't mean to hurt me. But it did hurt. I've lost everyone fifty-five times over. I'm terrified of being forgotten.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Something in this palace wants us to doubt each other. It's feeding on our fear. We can't let it win.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Together. We face it together.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: This is your fault. Both of you. You made me feel like I was nothing.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Mika! That's not fair and you know it!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Fair? Nothing about this is fair.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Look, you can't be the maid, Lira. You're terrible at it. But you can be the Princess's guard. And I can be the maid. We both have our roles.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: I like that idea. I'll guard the door, you handle the tea.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I think... I think I can live with that.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Forget the maid thing for a second. Look at this handprint. It's not human. It's shadow magic.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: The Demon Lord? He's here?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: No. Something older. Something that wants us to tear each other apart.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Then we won't give it the satisfaction.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Lira places Mika's pale ribbon on the table instead of putting it on. She waits for Mika to decide what it means, a gesture of ultimate respect.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: I want both of you here. Not as copies of one another—as yourselves. You both mean the world to me.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: I was scared. I still am. But I don't want fear choosing for me.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika picks up the ribbon and ties it back into her hair. The garden lanterns flare to life one by one, pushing back the darkness.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'm not going anywhere. And I'm not going to let a little jealousy ruin this. We're a team.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Agreed. We are stronger together.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I need time. I'm not ready to just pretend everything is okay.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Okay. Take all the time you need. We'll be here when you're ready.

choices.text: Ask Mallory to tie it for you

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I can't do it myself. My hands are shaking. Can you...?

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mallory steps forward, gently gathering Mika's hair and tying the ribbon. Her hands are warm and steady.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: There. Perfect. Welcome home, Mika.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Actually, Lira, you should wear it. As a promise. To protect the Princess.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: I... I would be honored.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: And you, Mika? What will you wear?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I don't need a ribbon. I have you two.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika returns to the household by choice. Mallory keeps Lira as her maid and Mika takes charge of the palace staff; Lira remains the princess's trusted guard and closest confidante.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: No one here needs to disappear for someone else to belong. We're a team. A weird, chaotic team.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: Then let us keep the table wide enough for all of us.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: For the first time in weeks, the palace feels like a place of warmth, rather than a fortress under siege.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Let's eat! I'm starving!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I'll have the chefs prepare a feast!

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Okay. Sounds good.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: ... Is everything alright, Mika?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Yeah. Just tired. Let's get some rest.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: We can celebrate after we survive the next assassination attempt. Let's run drills in the garden.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: I'll get the wooden swords. You're no fun, Mika.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'm alive. That's the point.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: That handprint in the archive. It's been bothering me. What if it's not just a prank?

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: The archives are ancient. There are things down there that even the King doesn't know about.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Then we should explore them. Tomorrow. Right now, let's eat.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A hidden faction tries to strike at the royal family during a moonlit walk. Lira spots the glint of a blade first, a flash of silver in the bushes.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: Mika, down! Assassin on the east wall!

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika throws herself in front of Mallory, catching a poisoned dart on her armored sleeve. The three women fight back-to-back, a perfect unit.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Stay behind me! I won't let them touch you!

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: The palace is safer when we trust each other enough to share the watch.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Thank you, Mika. You saved my life.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'll hunt them down. They won't get far.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Careful! It could be a trap!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika charges into the darkness, determined to end the threat permanently.

choices.text: Use the assassin's poison against them

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: They're using poison. That means they're cowards. Lira, cover me. I'm going to make them taste their own medicine.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika scoops up the poisoned dart and hurls it back into the bushes. A muffled gasp confirms her aim was true.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Remind me never to get on your bad side.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Lira, don't kill them! We need one alive!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Lira knocks the assassin out with the flat of her blade and drags him into the light.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: He's wearing the King's colors. But the crest is wrong.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: A fake. Someone is trying to frame the King.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The trail leads below the old archive. A locked door opens from the other side. Standing there is Councilman Vane Blackwood, holding a glowing, dark artifact, his eyes clouded with dark magic.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: You. You're the one who poisoned the wells. You killed our scouts. Why?

lines.speaker: Vane Blackwood
lines.text: For the glory of Vallhelm! The Demon Lord promised me power beyond imagination!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika disarms Vane with a swift strike, pinning him to the ground.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Take him away. Let him rot in the dungeons for his crimes.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Justice will be served. Thank you, Mika.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika's blade flashes in the dim light. Vane falls to the ground, the dark artifact shattering into dust.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: You die now. Traitors don't deserve a trial.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Mika, no... It wasn't your place to execute him.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika ignores Vane, swinging her sword at the glowing artifact. It shatters, and Vane screams as the dark magic leaves him, leaving him a weeping, broken man.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: He's not a traitor. He's a victim. Take him to the healers.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: You broke the spell. You saved him.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Who gave you the artifact? Tell me!

outcome_lines.speaker: Vane Blackwood
outcome_lines.text: The shadow... it spoke to me. It promised me a crown.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: A crown? Not power?

outcome_lines.speaker: Vane Blackwood
outcome_lines.text: The Demon Lord is just a pawn. The real darkness is the one whispering in the throne room.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The conspirators are stopped, but the battle leaves Mika's old wounds burning. She tries to hide the tremor in her hands from the others.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: You don't have to be useful to deserve rest. Let me bandage that.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: Then tonight, we keep watch while you heal. You've earned a moment of peace.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mallory gently cleans Mika's wounds, humming a soft lullaby. Mika finally allows herself to relax, leaning into Mallory's touch.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Thank you. Both of you. For making me feel human again.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Always, Mika. Always.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Leave me. I can take care of myself.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: ... As you wish. We'll be right outside if you need us.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika sits alone in the dark, wincing as she tries to bandage her own wounds.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Bandages are nice, but I could really use a cup of coffee. Or whatever the fantasy equivalent is.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I think we can manage some tea. Stay right here.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: For the first time in a long time, Mika laughs.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: The book said there was a true enemy. Older than the Demon Lord. What if the shadow was talking about itself?

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Then we need a plan. We can't just wait for it to attack.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Agreed. We rest tonight, and we plan tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The old book reveals one final warning: a darkness older than the Demon Lord is drawing near. The true enemy approaches.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: I found a way to focus the magic without asking Mika to carry it all. We can channel it together. A shared burden.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: Then we face the storm as a family, with the whole kingdom behind us.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Fifty-five times I did this alone. Not this time. Let's do it together.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Yes. Together.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The ground trembles. The black winter has arrived.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: No. I'll do it. I'm the champion, aren't I? I'm the one who has to make the sacrifice.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Stubborn fool. You don't have to carry this alone.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The ground trembles. The black winter has arrived.

choices.text: Ask for more details about the darkness

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: What exactly is the darkness? Is it a monster? A spell? A person?

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: The book says it has no face. It is the absence of hope itself.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Then we give it a face. And we punch it.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: There has to be a way to weaken it before it gets here. Something in the library?

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: The forbidden section. The King would have our heads.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: He'll have our heads anyway if we lose. Let's go.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: On the eve of the black winter, the four keep watch at the garden fountain. The sky is an inky void, devoid of stars.

lines.speaker: Shadow
lines.text: [shake]Fifty-five times you died alone. The fifty-sixth will end the pattern. You will break.[/shake]

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: You're wrong. This time, I have people who know my name.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The shadow smiles with Mika's own face and vanishes beneath the ice.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I have people who know my name. I am not alone.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: We are here. We will always be here.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The shadow smiles with Mika's own face and vanishes beneath the ice.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Maybe I will break. Maybe this is the time I finally fail.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: Don't say that. We need you to be strong.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: You're a shadow. You're literally a spooky voice in the dark. I've cleaned up scarier things than you.

outcome_lines.speaker: Shadow
outcome_lines.text: You mock me?

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I mock bad hotel carpet stains. You're not even top ten.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The shadow recoils, confused by her defiance.

choices.text: Ask the shadow why it's doing this

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Why? Why do you keep bringing me back just to kill me?

outcome_lines.speaker: Shadow
outcome_lines.text: Because your suffering is delicious. Each time you break, I grow stronger.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: Then I'll stop breaking. I'll become something you can't swallow.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: And we'll be right there with her.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Winter turns the sky black. Beyond the walls, a vast shadow opens over Vallhelm. The final battle is at hand.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: Fifty-six lives, and I finally know what I want to protect.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
text: Whatever happens out there... I love you, Mika. I should have said it sooner.
Whatever happens out there... I love you, Mika. I should have said it sooner.
Whatever happens out there... I love you, Mika. I should have said it sooner.
Whatever happens out there... I want to trust you, Mika. But there's a darkness in your eyes that I've seen before. Please, prove me wrong.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I love you too. Let's end this. Together.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Let's go.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: They charge into the darkness, side by side.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Mika? Please, say something.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: There's no time for words. We have a battle to win.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: I'll come back. I swear. You won't have to wait for me this time.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: I'll hold you to that.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: They share a brief, fierce embrace before turning to face the storm.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika steps forward and kisses Mallory, a fierce, desperate kiss that tastes of tears and hope.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: For luck.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: Come back to me, Mika.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The sky cracks open. The ancient shadow descends, a massive entity of writhing darkness and glowing red eyes.

lines.speaker: Shadow
lines.text: [color=#ff0000]You are nothing but a servant. You cannot defeat me.[/color]

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: I am a servant. But I am also a hero. And this is my home!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika raises her weapon, channeling all her power into a single strike. Mallory and Lira stand beside her, combining their magic.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: [shake]Together![/shake]

outcome_lines.speaker: Shadow
outcome_lines.text: Impossible!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika pushes Mallory and Lira out of the way, charging directly into the shadow.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: [shake]I'll do it alone![/shake]

outcome_lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
outcome_lines.text: No! Mika!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika looks at the crumbling ruins around them. She dodges a blast of shadow and brings the entire ceiling down on top of the entity.

outcome_lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
outcome_lines.text: She's insane! Brilliant, but insane!

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: The shadow roars as it is crushed under tons of stone.

choices.text: Use the power of the 55 lives

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: Mika closes her eyes, reaching into the depths of her soul. She feels all 55 of her past lives, all their pain, all their love.

outcome_lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
outcome_lines.text: You killed me 55 times. Now I'm going to use every single one of those deaths to kill you.

outcome_lines.speaker: Narration
outcome_lines.text: A brilliant golden light erupts from her body, obliterating the shadow.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Together, they break the ancient shadow. The entity shatters into a million pieces of light. Mika falls to her knees, exhausted.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: You came back. You are loved, Mika. You are home.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: As long as a fragment of me remains, I will always find my way back to you. This time, I am staying home. Forever.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: The dawn is breaking. We actually did it.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The weeks that follow are a blur of rebuilding and celebration. The kingdom throws a festival in Mika's honor, but she spends most of it hiding in the kitchens, baking pies with the staff.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mallory finds her there, covered in flour, laughing with the scullery maids.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: The hero of Vallhelm, everyone! Hiding from her own party.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: I'm not hiding. I'm just... organizing the dessert table. It's a very important job.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mallory takes her hand, pulling her into a dance among the ovens and hanging pots.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: I love you, Mika Amanogawa. Not because you're a hero. But because you're you.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: I love you too, Mallory. And I promise, no more dying. At least, not for a very long time.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Lira watches from the doorway, a rare smile on her face. The cycle is finally broken. And for the first time in fifty-six lives, Mika is truly home.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Years pass. The kingdom flourishes. And the summoning circle remains dark, never to be used again.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The goblin alliance turns the tide. Together, the people of Vallhelm shatter the darkness and keep their promise of peace.

lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
lines.text: Today we fought as neighbors. Let us live that way tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: I used to think protecting people meant standing in front of them. Now I know it can mean standing beside them.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: A new era of unity begins. Goblins and humans rebuild the kingdom together, and Mika stands at the center of it all.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Months later, the first joint harvest festival is held in the lower city. Humans and goblins trade goods, share stories, and dance around a massive bonfire.

lines.speaker: Gorthak Stonefist
lines.text: You changed everything, Mika. You gave my people a future.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: I just cleaned up the mess. You did the fighting.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: Don't sell yourself short. You brought us together. You gave us hope.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika looks at the fire, at the faces of her friends, and finally feels the heavy burden of the prophecy lift from her shoulders.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: You know, I think this world might just be my home after all.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The kingdom of Vallhelm becomes a beacon of unity, and Mika Amanogawa, the maid who saved the world, is remembered not as a weapon, but as a bridge.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika meets the darkness alone and wins, though the familiar cycle claims its price once more.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: In the quiet that follows, Mallory and Lira refuse to let her go. Their voices guide her back to the garden.

lines.speaker: Mika Amanogawa
lines.text: I will try again. Next time, I will let you stand beside me.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: I'll be waiting for you. Always.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: But the world resets. The kingdom is restored, the wounds are healed, and the summoning circle begins to glow once more.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: King Galvath is alive. The Demon Lord is a distant threat. And Mallory sits on her throne, a strange, painful ache in her chest that she cannot explain.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: She doesn't know why she cries when the mages attempt the summoning. She doesn't know why she feels a mix of hope and dread when the golden light fills the hall.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: But when she sees the maid with the feather duster appear, Mallory knows one thing for certain: this time, she will not let her die alone.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Rain hammers against the stained glass of the throne room. Mika stands before the King and Lira, her maid's dress soaked in mud, blood, and rain. In her trembling hands, she holds the shattered hilt of Mallory's sword.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mallory had ridden to the border, believing she could negotiate a truce with the neighboring kingdom. Instead, they had strung her up like a banner of war. Her body now lay in the palace infirmary, cold and lifeless.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: Mika, please... say something. You've been silent for hours.

lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
lines.text: It was her choice to go! She knew the risks of diplomacy! We must not let her sacrifice be in vain. We rally the troops! We burn their kingdom to the ground!

lines.speaker: Mika_Evil
lines.text: [shake]Her choice?[/shake]

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika's voice is unnervingly quiet, a sharp contrast to the King's booming rage.

lines.speaker: Mika_Evil
lines.text: [shake]You sent her there. You knew it was a trap. You wanted a martyr to rally your pathetic army.[/shake]

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: Mika, no! That's treason! The King would never—

lines.speaker: King Galvath Valerius
lines.text: Watch your tongue, servant! I am your King, and I will not be spoken to in such a manner by a scullery maid!

lines.speaker: Mika_Evil
lines.text: [shake]TODAY I HAD ENOUGH OF YOUR RUDENESS![/shake]

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika brandishes her sword, the blade singing a terrible, high-pitched note as it leaves the scabbard. The guards barely have time to draw their weapons before she lunges at the King, cutting him down in a single, devastating arc.

lines.speaker: Lira Vanguard
lines.text: NO! Mika, stop! You're betraying everything Mallory stood for! You're betraying her!

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Lira draws her blade, tears streaming down her face. She steps between Mika and the throne, her hands shaking.

lines.speaker: Mika_Evil
lines.text: [shake]Betraying her? I am the only one who loved her![/shake]

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: With a feral scream, Mika clashes with Lira. The fight is brutal, a whirlwind of steel and grief. Mika's grief gives her a terrifying strength. She parries Lira's strike and drives her blade deep into the Captain's chest.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Lira falls, her blood pooling on the marble floor. Mika stands alone in the throne room, surrounded by the bodies of the King and the Captain.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika reaches down, her fingers slick with blood, and plucks the heavy golden crown from the dead King's head. She places it upon her own brow, the cold metal a stark contrast to the heat of the burning kingdom.

lines.speaker: Mika_Evil
lines.text: The kingdom is mine now. I will kill them all. Every single one of them. For Mallory.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The girl who was once a maid is gone. In her place stands the Queen of Ash, her heart consumed by the very darkness she swore to destroy.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The reign of Queen Mika begins in blood. She does not stop with the neighboring kingdom. She burns everything. And when the world is ash, she sits on the throne, wearing Mallory's ribbon, waiting for a reset that will never come.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The other kingdom's forces surround them. Mallory is injured, leaning heavily on Mika. The rain is cold, washing the blood from their wounds.

lines.speaker: Mika_Evil
lines.text: I'll save you from them, Mallory. I'll protect you. Just trust me.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: I trust you, Mika. Always. We'll get through this. Together.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika smiles, a soft, broken thing. She leans in close, as if to embrace the Princess. Instead, she drives a concealed dagger deep into Mallory's back.

lines.speaker: Mallory Valerius
lines.text: M-Mika...? Why...?

lines.speaker: Mika_Evil
lines.text: I can't save you. I couldn't save anyone. But I can reset the world. I can try again. I can bring you back.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mallory's eyes widen in shock and despair. She reaches out, her fingers brushing Mika's tear-stained cheek, before her body goes limp.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: As the light fades from Mallory's eyes, a terrible realization dawns on her. On the next reset, her trust in Mika will be forever shattered, even though the events remain unchanged. The cycle begins anew.

lines.speaker: Mika_Evil
lines.text: I'll fix it. I'll fix everything. Just wait for me, Mallory.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Mika pulls the dagger from Mallory's back and turns it on herself, casting the reset spell with her own blood. The world twists, shatters, and reforms.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: But something is wrong. The spell is corrupted. Mika is not a hero anymore. She is a ghost in the machine. And Mallory... Mallory is terrified.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: The new timeline begins with Mallory looking at Mika not with love, but with pure, unadulterated fear. And Mika? Mika just smiles, ready to try again.
